violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregivers were not able to intervene when a child was able to leave the playground and run into the parking lot.

finding_variants.text: Caregivers were not able to intervene when a child was able to leave the playground and run into the parking lot.

During naptime, there was one caregiver supervising 2 classrooms. However, the caregiver was not properly supervising both rooms at the same time when she came into one classroom leaving the other room unsupervised at a period of time.

A caregiver's ability to supervise and intervene to protect a child in care was limited due to the placement of furnishings in the room, resulting in one child hitting another with a heavy toy, causing injury.
It was found during the investigation that caregivers left children alone inside of a classroom while the children were napping.
A pre-k classroom was briefly left unsupervised for a minute when a caregiver stepped out of the classroom.

A caregiver did not timely intervene on the playground when a child's safety was at risk. The plastic kitchen was pushed over onto the ground on top of a child and additional children were sitting on the child through the openings of the kitchen. Additional children sitting on top of the kitchen and pushing each other.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information obtained, caregivers did not intervene to ensure children's safety when a child was bitten.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: It was determined that a caregiver did not intervene to ensure a child's safety. The caregiver did not respond to the needs of the child after they fell and injured themselves on the playground. The caregiver did not report the injury to management and just took the child back to class where they sat for thirty minutes before another staff intervened.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Caregivers did not intervene as children climbed a play structure incorrectly.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Inappropriately physical contact occurred between two children.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: DFPS interviews identified that the caregiver in question failed to intervene to ensure children?s safety on multiple occasions resulting in child injuries.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A child was able to exit the playground away from the caregiver responsible for them, without the caregiver knowing. The child was without a caregiver able to intervene for a short while.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found to be deficient. A caregiver did not intervene when a child re-entered the classroom alone and climbed on cots resulting in the child sustaining minor injuries.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on a video recording taken and posted, the caregiver did not intervene and redirect two children who were fighting.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: While a child was playing, the child's hand resulted in an open displaced fracture to his thumb.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the evidence obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support that caregivers were not adequately supervising children in care during outdoor play which resulted in a child sustaining an injury.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A caregiver failed to supervise and intervene to prevent harm to a child, who was struck with a fake flowerpot and sustained an injury requiring medical services.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and was found to be deficient. Children were climbing on a pole with a material game piece.  The caregivers did not intervene which resulted in one child climbing then falling. This resulted in the child receiving a head injury needing medical attention.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Caregiver failed to intervene to ensure child's safety during a physical altercation with another child.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information obtained, caregivers were not able to intervene when a child was bitten in care.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Caregivers failed to prevent a child who was swinging a chair from throwing it and injuring a peer.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the preponderance of evidence gathered, there is sufficient evidence to determine deficiencies related to this investigation regarding supervision. The caregiver did not intervene when the children were fighting at the basketball court.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: During a review of a DFPS investigation, this standard was reviewed and found to be deficient.  Children engaged in rough play and fighting without caregiver intervention.  The caregiver was cleaning up snack, and the children were not visual awareness.  Based on the lack of intervention, there was not auditory awareness to allow for caregiver intervention.  The child altercation resulted in minor injuries.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A child in care received a serious accidental injury associated with inappropriate play. The caregiver supervising the children at the time is observed on video footage sitting down while supervising the children. The caregiver is not observed proactively walking around the care area(s) maintaining close proximity to intervene/redirect children's activities.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Three children under 5 years old on three different occasions went to the restrooms by themselves without direct caregiver supervision.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: During a series of incidents involving a child in care receiving injuries from another child(ren), a caregiver is observed sitting down when supervising children. The caregiver is not observed proactively walking around the care area(s) maintaining close proximity to intervene/anticipate risk.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: The caregiver failed to intervene in a timely manner to prevent an unsafe situation.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and was found to be deficient. Caregivers failed to intervene when a child caused harm to another child, which caused a child to receive injuries.  There were multiple incidents of physical altercations between children in the same day.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information obtained during the course of this investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not maintain visual awareness of each child's ongoing activity to provide the level of supervision necessary to ensure each child's safety and well-being as two children engaged in a physical altercation.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Caregiver did not intervene when multiple children were playing with bathroom door resulting in injury.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient. Caregivers did not intervene to protect the safety of the child.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A cargiver was observed supervising a child in the bathroom from the doorway of their classroom and would have been unable to intervene without leaving their class unsupervised if the child needed help.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: There are concerns with supervision

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. Through interviews with staff, it was determined that caregivers and administrative staff were aware of a broken cover for a hose connection box on the playground; however, the caregivers did not have an increased level of supervision for the box and as a result a child received a minor injury from the hose connection box.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A caregiver repeatedly left the room, leaving the caregiver responsible for infants to supervise 2 spaces at one time.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: It was determined during the investigation that the caregiver did not intervene to provide the victim with first aid treatment. The victim's eye was injured. Ice or other medical aid was not provided to the victim. The caregiver took the child back to the classroom after the injury on the playground and did not notify her immediate supervisor or another caregiver that the victim needed first aid for their injured eye, nor did the caregiver attempt to provided first aid themselves for the victim. The victim remained in the classroom injured until the parent picked up without first aid being provided.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on evidence from video footage, a caregiver did not intervene timely when a child was biting another child and received multiple bite marks.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the evidence obtained it is determined that the operation was not in compliance with supervision as the caregiver was not able to intervene to avoid the accident form occurring.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: In the documentation completed as part of a DFPS investigation, it was found that an unsupervised infant child was injured by older children who were also unsupervised while in care at the operation. The infant child required medical attention for the injuries that the received.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the investigation and information obtained the operation is not in compliance.  The caregiver failed to take appropriate action to stop the children from running, which did compromise the safety of a child.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information obtained, caregivers did not intervene to ensure children's safety when a child fell on top of another child while on the playground.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information gathered during the course of a DFPS investigation, it was found that a caregiver did not intervene when a child was injured while rolling around in the mulch loose fill on the playground.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: During the investigation, it was found that caregivers failed to intervene after observing a group of children playing with jump ropes, resulting in children placing jump ropes around their own and other children?s necks.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a caregiver did not take into consideration the circumstances and the surroundings when putting a group of children in line for an amount of time that allowed children to start pushing each other resulting in a child hitting their eyebrow and needing medical treatment. Caregiver did not intervene on time.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Evidence obtained during the investigation shows that a child was left on the playground alone. While other staff were outside during this time, they were unaware that the child was there and did not have auditory or visual awareness of the child. This prevented the caregivers who were outside from being able to intervene if the need had arisen.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: The caregivers responsible for the children did not quickly intervene or respond to a child falling down a slide.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A caregiver did not make necessary adjustments during diaper changing and failed to intervene when a child was bitten three times.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Caregivers were observed diapering and sweeping the floor while children were climbing into and on top of furniture.  Biting incidents reported have occurred when children have become frustrated during conflicts over toys.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: There was sufficient evidence found during an investigation to support that an infant was able to climb out of a highchair and hit their head on the floor without a caregiver intervening.  One caregiver was changing a diaper, and another caregiver was sitting on the floor feeding another infant.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: It was observed a caregiver answering the door and leaving four children alone ages 10 months, four, five and six years old.     It was observed a child came from inside alone when the child was hurt on the playground.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the findings of a DFPS investigation a caregiver did not intervene to ensure safety by picking up a barefoot child or by stopping to put the child's shoes on instead of continuing to walk across hot pavement when they noticed the child's shoes were not on. The child's feet sustained burns. Prior to transitioning from the playground back to class supervision was not maintained on the playground as caregivers sat down on the playground and were not walking around and intervening where appropriate. They were not ensuring this child's shoes (and others stayed on) or seek assistance. More than one child walked back to class without shoes on when transitioning from the playground back to class.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, an incident occurred where children were repeatedly climbing on shelves during nap time in the classroom and the caregiver failed to intervene. The caregiver sat on the ground instead of removing the children from the shelves to ensure their safety. The caregiver doesn?t attempt to redirect the children until after a child falls off the shelf and lands onto another child laying on their nap mat resulting in the other child crying.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was reviewed in relation to the allegations and found to be deficient. A child was found alone and unharmed in a classroom by a collateral parent.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Per the DFPS investigation, a caregiver allowed children to incorrectly climb up a slide and jump off an indoor play equipment.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information obtained, caregivers did not intervene to guide a child when a child stood at the bottom of a slide and jumped off of the slide and injured themselves.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information gathered during the DFPS Investigation, a child was left unsupervised for approximately 20 minutes. Caregiver was unaware of child's whereabouts. Child was found in the roadway by a passerby and brought back to the operation, unharmed.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Evidence obtained during the investigation shows that a child was left on the playground alone for three minutes. While other staff were outside during this time, they were unaware that the child was there. Due to this, no staff had auditory or visual awareness of the child's ongoing activities and could not have intervened if necessary.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A video was observed showing one child biting another child. The caregivers were not able to intervene because they were on their phones.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on a DFPS investigation caregivers at the center failed to intervene when a child received bites, scratches and bruising.
